title: CRO (Conversion Rate Optimization) Expert – B2B – Brussels
full_description:
Your Role & Work Environment
As a CRO Expert, you are the driving force behind our digital sales and customer growth acceleration. You transform data into action, experiments into breakthroughs, and friction into seamless experiences. In a fast‑moving digital landscape, you orchestrate meaningful improvements across our sales funnels — from the very first click to the final sale – to push up conversion rates.
In this role, you will be working in Easy Banking, our Digital Sales B2B team driving growth for our Self-employed & Micro companies in Belgium. This is an exciting segment, with a focus on start-ups and entrepreneurs – the backbone of our economy and future growth.

Conversion & Experimentation
